description: Baseline: random init, untouched weights; prints the task object's public attributes to learn the format.
Baseline: random init, untouched weights; prints task sequence lengths and method signatures.
Baseline: random init, untouched weights; prints non-eval-seed examples and black-box is_correct behaviour.
READ heads with place-value attention; slope-hypothesis tests for k=1..5; gated extrapolation; tangent-line rounding head. No LayerNorm.
SlopeBank01 with one '=' token flag replacing the two position flags for the tens/units step (one fewer channel).
Two blocks, no PRINT layer: at '=' each head also attends to the zero-valued '=' so numbers read at 1/10 volume and the same FIT bank yields y/10 for tens, y-10t for units.
VolumeKnob03 with each number's channel doubling as its attention address (d_model 21 to 14), since addresses and values never share a position.
No MLP or ReLU: two attention layers. Slope heads gate on the bilinear score -beta*e_k^2, staying on themselves only if slope k fits, else falling back to a zero-valued position.
AttnOnly05 with the ref channel merged into stay: READ's muted positions find the fallback ',' through its high stay value.
AttnOnly06 with one, eq and mute replaced by two position channels: live (answer steps) and phase (prompt -1, tens +1, units 0).
AttnOnly07 with registers y1, dy, dx, dq instead of the five raw numbers; W_o subtracts on the way in, so FIT reads e_k = dy - k dx and y_k = y1 + k dq.
AttnOnly08 with five one-hot address channels replaced by a 2-D compass code: each number has a direction, radius is place value, each READ head points its key one way.
Compass09 with attention sharpness L lowered from 40 to 15, measuring how soft READ can be.
Compass09 with L=8, expected to break: read leakage between compass neighbours should leave e_k nonzero for the true slope.
Compass09 with stay gaps of 10 instead of 100, so beta falls from 40000 to 2000; L=12. Smaller weights and a gate more tolerant of read noise.
Compass12 with L=20: keeps the gentle beta=2000 gate and restores the read margin that L=12 lacked (0.9998 on the larger check).
Ablation of Compass13: remove the k=5 FIT head. Prediction: about 80%, failing exactly when the true slope is 5.
Ablation of Compass13: remove the -0.45 floor shift at '='. Prediction: about 50%, the tens digit rounding up whenever the units digit is 5 or more.
Ablation of Compass13: '=' no longer dilutes the reads. Prediction: about 1%, tens clips to 9 for y>=10 so only y=0 survives.
Ablation of Compass13: units step no longer outranks the tens step. Prediction: 15-20%, a fitting head averages y/10 and the units digit.
Ablation of Compass13: prompt positions are not muted. Prediction: under 10%, wrong heads lock onto garbage registers through the bilinear cross-term.
Compass13 with slope 3 as a null hypothesis: READ writes y1 + 3 dq into out and FIT has 4 correction heads; d_model 10.
NullSlope19 with dig removed: digit tokens are -10d in out, READ takes value -0.1 out, and the floor shift moves into the head via phase; d_model 9.
NullSlope20 with correction heads for all slopes 0-9, plus an out-of-distribution diagnostic on lines the task never generates, testing whether this is a general line solver.
NullSlope20 with pre-LN and final LN restored: +-A anchor channels pin the std, LN gains undo it, and a zero channel cancels the mean in every read row; d_model 12.
Same circuit in the unmodified default architecture (d_model 64, 4 heads, 3 layers, zeroed MLPs, all LayerNorms): block 1 reads four numbers, block 2 reads x, block 3 fits.
DefaultArch23 with a dedicated dig channel for read values, because block 1 writes into out at '=' and broke block 2's zero-valued '=' volume knob.
DefaultArch24 unchanged, adding an exhaustive diagnostic over all 45000 inputs in the observed ranges instead of relying on samples.
Compact26 with L=14: uses the exhaustive check to test how soft READ can be, since L=12 lost 1/5000 in sampling.
The compact circuit (NullSlope20: d_model 9, 2 attention layers, 9 heads, no MLP or LayerNorm) under the exhaustive diagnostic over all 45000 inputs.
